name: gausswin
setup: w15 = gausswin(8, 1.5); w25 = gausswin(8); w4 = gausswin(16, 4); w8 = gausswin(64, 8); w1 = gausswin(1, 4);
comment: Sig: w = gausswin(N[, alpha]). Gaussian window with reciprocal-of-stddev shape param alpha (default 2.5). Larger alpha -> tighter / lower endpoints. Coverage: alpha ∈ {1.5, 2.5, 4, 8} × N ∈ {8, 16, 64} sample points + N=1 (single-point window).
